deployments_detail.use: "核智·龙灵"(Longling) large model + DeepSeek integration via "核智AI门户"; AI intelligent design/construction, smart maintenance, core-reactivity verification; unmanned-plant demo

Qinshan Nuclear Power's 'i-知识' (i-Knowledge) management platform — CNNP's first LLM-based knowledge system, combining large language models, intelligent retrieval, knowledge graphs and semantic analysis over nuclear-industry knowledge, delivering domain-specific Q&A and knowledge-element-level standards retrieval. Passed expert appraisal Aug 2024. [Large language model (nuclear-domain LLM)]

'核智·龙灵' (HeZhi Longling) nuclear-operations large model and '核智 AI 门户' (HeZhi AI portal) built by CNNP's Nuclear Power Operation Research Institute, integrated with DeepSeek. Deployed scenarios include automatic work-dispatch order generation (派遣单生成), regulation/policy intelligent Q&A, and O&M knowledge Q&A; later upgraded to integrate DeepSeek-V4 with doubled parameter count. [DeepSeek (V3/R1, later V4); self-developed Longling model]

Digital-twin-driven pressurized-water-reactor core operation support system by CNNP's Nuclear Power Operation Research Institute — uses 3D multi-physics high-precision core computation combined with machine-learning calibration to align digital models with actual reactor data. Selected as the only nuclear-sector case in MIIT's 2025 AI typical application cases list. [Machine learning; in-house 3D core computation]

'核电人工智能数智协同赋能平台' (nuclear-power AI digital-intelligence collaborative enablement platform) developed by CNNP subsidiary CNNC Wuhan (中核武汉), selected into MIIT's 2025 AI industry / new industrialization 'unveiling & leading' (揭榜挂帅) shortlist.

Sanmen Nuclear Power (三门核电, controlled ~56% by CNNP) named the world's first nuclear-power 'Lighthouse Factory' by the World Economic Forum, recognized for high automation, data-driven decision-making and rapid adoption of Fourth Industrial Revolution / AI technologies across plant operations.

Qinshan Nuclear Power's 5G private network (largest electricity 5G private network in China, covering all 9 units) supporting AI-enabled digital applications including intelligent video surveillance (视频智能监控), digital operating procedures, radiation-source supervision and smart metering. [China Mobile Zhejiang (5G network)]

Qinshan Nuclear Power smart water project (智慧水务) — China's first smart-water project in the nuclear sector, at the Qin-2 Chengjing intake, applying intelligent modeling/algorithms for automated intake operation. Commissioned Dec 2021.

Qinshan Nuclear Power AI intelligent inspection robots in plant buildings — over the 5G private network, robots link AI HD cameras and explosion-proof pan-tilt devices, using image recognition for automatic meter reading, leak/anomaly detection, infrared temperature measurement and gas monitoring, replacing manual inspection in the secondary loop and other areas.

Sanmen Nuclear Power 'AI digital employee' (数字员工) software project — AI-based automation of email processing, archive checking, document cataloguing, business-ledger management and financial-data processing to replace manual back-office tasks (procured via tender).

'基于大模型的核电网络安全风险监测诊断平台' (large-model-based nuclear-power cybersecurity risk monitoring & diagnosis platform), a CNNP project selected into MIIT's 2025 AI 'unveiling & leading' (揭榜挂帅) shortlist — applies LLMs to network-security risk monitoring and diagnosis for nuclear plants. [Large language model]
